rationale: Possible mismatch: the vote is on Police Ordinance Amendment No. 43, but the bill text provided is for Amendment No. 44 (water-cannon use at demonstrations: clean water only, mandatory audio-visual recording kept at least a year, and access to that recording for people claiming harm). I left the summaries empty so the wrong bill isn't attached to this vote. Please confirm which amendment was voted on. If it is No. 44, it touches police oversight but none of the watch topics squarely, so it does not look like a key vote.
